name: Mis-classification of dual-use item
description: Item shipped under wrong ECCN / dual-use classification; restricted item exported without licence.

name: Restricted end-use / end-user
description: Item ships to a customer whose actual end-use is restricted (military, WMD, sanctioned regime).

name: Re-routing through third country
description: Item shipped to apparently legitimate customer that re-exports to a sanctioned end-user.

name: Activity outside scope of OGEL / licence
description: Entity holds an OGEL / specific licence and ships outside its scope.

name: Deemed-export to foreign national
description: Controlled technology disclosed to a foreign national without licence (employee, contractor, visiting researcher).
